title: Dynamic Immune Responsiveness in Breast Cancer: Tumor Microenvironment Plasticity, Therapeutic Timing, and Clinical Translation.
snippet: Breast cancer immunotherapy has advanced substantially, yet durable clinical benefit remains limited to selected patient populations, reflecting heterogeneity in tumor-immune interactions across molecular subtypes, disease stages, and treatment contexts.
